method: Read the archive member without modifying the archive or ADF.
Read the FFS file-header record at block 244 and take first-data block 245.
Concatenate blocks 245 through 253 in order, trim to the header's 4432-byte file length, and hash the result.
Search only printable embedded strings in the recovered bytes.
limits: Static strings do not define the directive grammar, accepted abbreviations, substitution order, output stream, return level, or IoErr.
This capture does not execute the original binary and is not a behavioral oracle.
The original binary itself is not copied into this repository.
